The [[MCD:Illager|Illagers]] capture the defenseless [[MCD:Villager|Villagers]] and move them east, toward their mysterious base in the [[MCD:Redstone Mines|Redstone Mines]]. The first step in their ruthless journey starts by going through Creeper Woods, a mob infested maze of tangled roots and branches. Move quickly if you wish to save the Villagers from a terrible fate!

'''Creeper Woods''' is the second [[MCD:Mainland|mainland]] [[MCD:Mission|mission]]. It is unlocked after the completion of {{MCD|Squid Coast}}, and completing Creeper Woods unlocks {{MCD|Pumpkin Pastures}}, {{MCD|Soggy Swamp}}, {{MCD|Redstone Mines}}, {{MCD|Cacti Canyon}}, {{MCD|Treetop Tangle}}, and {{MCD|Gauntlet of Gales}}. It contains the captured [[MCD:Village Merchant|village merchant]].

It always generates the [[MCD:Creeper Woods Crypt|Creeper Woods Crypt]] optional [[MCD:Sub Dungeon|sub dungeon]] that contains a [[MCD:Scroll|scroll]] which, if collected, unlocks the {{MCD|Creepy Crypt}} [[MCD:Secret Mission|secret mission]].

== Appearance and description ==
{{Quote|'''CREEPER WOODS''' – Somewhere in the woods, a caravan is transporting Villager prisoners to labor in far-off lands. Your first quest is to find the caravan in this mob-infested maze and stop the Illagers, or there's no telling what dreadful fate will befall our Villager friends.|''Guide to Minecraft Dungeons:<br>A Handbook for Heroes''}}
Creeper Woods is a wooded area set at night, and contains monoliths, hills, narrow bridges, rope-bridge walkways, and rivers. It is foggy, dim, and eerily illuminated by yellow fungi and pop flowers, with creepers walking about the forest.<ref name="guide">Mojang, ''[[Guide to Minecraft Dungeons: A Handbook for Heroes]]'', Creeper Woods, pg. 47</ref> It contains two [[MCD:Chest#Supplies%20Chests|supply chests]], one in [[MCD:The Inn|The Inn]] before the spider cave, and one at the Illager caravan. Piles of emerald urns can be found in {{MCD|Creeper Room}}, an optional sub dungeon found early on in the mission. A fancy chest can also be found inside Creeper Room upon surviving the [[MCD:Arena Battle|ambush]] of creepers. Giant stone mob heads can be found in the lake at the start of the mission,<ref name="statue">Mojang, ''[[Guide to Minecraft Dungeons: A Handbook for Heroes]]'', Creeper Woods, pg. 48</ref> with the enderman one that can spawn only in the {{MCD|Echoing Void}} DLC indicating that {{MCD|Deepwood Brook}} can be found to the north-east of the lake. Near the end of the mission, an [[MCD:Illager|illager]] caravan can be found that contains five captured [[MCD:Villager|villagers]], as well as rudimentary jails made by the Illagers.<ref name="book">Mojang, ''[[Guide to Minecraft Dungeons: A Handbook for Heroes]]'', Creeper Woods, pg. 46</ref> The area is patrolled by [[MCD:Vindicator|vindicators]] to deter villagers from escaping,<ref name="book" /> and these illagers attack the hero on sight. To the south-west in the caravan area, a tomb can be found with a button that, if activated, reveals the entrance door of {{MCD|Creeper Woods Rune Room}}.<ref group=note name=note1>The entrance can only be revealed after defeating the Arch-Illager and pressing the button at the back of Great Hall.</ref> When a villager is freed it bows in thanks and vanishes, and once all five villagers are released a graveyard can be accessed beyond the gate to the north-west. Further north, a wooden bridge suspended over lava must be crossed to reach a stone brick temple which, if entered, ends the mission.

== Trivia ==
* Dark oak trees characteristic of the [[Dark Forest|dark forest]] [[biome]] from ''[[Minecraft]]'' do not exist in Creeper Woods.
* The song [[Minecraft Dungeons (Original Game Soundtrack)|Spider Den]] used in this mission is a slowed down version of the song [[Minecraft Dungeons (Original Game Soundtrack)|Crypt]].
* The ambient music that plays in this mission stops when entering the sidepath that leads to {{MCD|Deepwood Brook}}.
* {{MCD|Evoker}} death sounds occasionally play within the level.
